## Purpose

Continue the maintainer-directed design investigation after #590 / draft #592. The maintainer proposes individual Pydantic attribute contracts (`StrictInt`, ordinary types, custom `Annotated` validators/serializers) and prefers driver-value reads over best-effort unchecked decoding. Investigate using the same declared attribute with strict or ordinary validation in different operations.

## Deliverable

A bounded research report covering Pydantic's per-call strictness precedence, explicit strict annotations, constraints, custom validators, JSON/Python representation differences, operation-local policy, raw driver bypass and truthful result typing. Identify current snekql integration obstacles and unresolved decisions without selecting public syntax. Leave aggregate redesign for later.

## Scope

Source/documentation and existing-test inspection only, including installed Pydantic's public interfaces and upstream tests if available. No production/dependency changes, project/Pydantic model or validator execution, backend suites, benchmarks, new public settings, migration work or implementation. Clearly distinguish documented/source-supported behavior from newly executed behavioral evidence (none planned). A later characterization prototype needs separately confirmed public seams and TDD.
